title: Multiplicity and Regularity Results for Quasilinear Elliptic Systems via Nonsmooth Critical Point Theory
summary: We study the quasilinear elliptic system \[ -\textbf{div}(A(x,\boldsymbol u)|D\boldsymbol u|^{p-2}D\boldsymbol u) +\frac{1}{p}\nabla_{\boldsymbol s}A(x,\boldsymbol u)|D\boldsymbol u|^p = \boldsymbol g(x,\boldsymbol u) \quad \text{in } Ω, \qquad \boldsymbol u = 0 \text{ on } \partialΩ, \] where $p>1$, $Ω\subset\mathbb R^N$ is a bounded domain with $N>1$, and $\boldsymbol g$ satisfies a subcritical growth condition.
